_readme: Pulled 2026-09-27 from baincapitalcrypto.com/wp-json/wp/v2/portfolio (every row), plus the rendered /portfolio/ page, whose second grid (js-exited-list) is the firm's exited list.

rows.name: Turnkey
rows.content: Turnkey provides secure, scalable, and programmable crypto infrastructure for embedded wallets and onchain transaction automation.

rows.name: M0
rows.content: M0 is the universal platform powering builders of application‑specific stablecoins.

rows.name: Irreducible
rows.content: Irreducible provides fast and cost-effective computation of zero-knowledge succinct proofs.

rows.name: World
rows.content: World is building the world’s largest, most distributed privacy-preserving identity protocol.

rows.name: Puzzle
rows.content: Puzzle lets any organization go securely on-chain without compromising on privacy, auditability, or self-custody.

rows.name: Fuel
rows.content: Fuel delivers security and flexible throughput in a fast execution layer for modular blockchains.

rows.name: Flood
rows.content: Flood is a DeFi aggregator that works to provide the best price available for all supported assets.

rows.name: Celestia
rows.content: Celestia is a modular consensus and data network that lets anyone deploy their own blockchain with minimal overhead.

rows.name: Risc Zero
rows.content: Risc Zero is maximizing the utility of advanced cryptography through products like Bonsai.xyz, which allows devs to access limitless compute.

rows.name: Curio
rows.content: Curio is building the next-generation of fully on-chain games and related gaming infrastructure.

rows.name: Orb Labs
rows.content: Orb Labs is building protocols and tools for developers to build affordable, secure cross-chain applications.

rows.name: Primitive
rows.content: Primitive builds products that make discovering popular AMM liquidity pools and strategies easier.

rows.name: Duality
rows.content: Duality unlocks fair and more efficient markets by letting traders and liquidity providers own their experience.

rows.name: Skip
rows.content: Skip enables better user experiences across crypto by building transparent blockspace markets that connect traders and blockchains.

rows.name: Community Labs
rows.content: Community Labs builds critical developer tools and solutions for the Arweave ecosystem.

rows.name: Jadu
rows.content: Jadu AR is building the Jadu Mirrorverse — an augmented reality game-world that is owned by its community.

rows.name: Scroll
rows.content: Scroll is an Ethereum L2 solution that uses ZK Rollups to deliver a secure, scalable execution layer that is compatible with EVM.

rows.name: Variational Research
rows.content: Variational Research is a global algorithmic market maker and liquidity provider focused on digital assets. We partner with both DeFi protocols and financial institutions/fintechs to help bridge the gap between traditional and decentralized finance. Variational is backed by Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Dragonfly Capital, North Island Ventures, and many others.
